# GENmarketer — Your AI team

> GENmarketer sells a team of 28 AI marketing specialists that the customer installs into their own Claude or ChatGPT account. Each specialist is a packaged expert — market researcher, ad copywriter, Google Ads manager, landing page expert, SEO auditor, email expert and more — that does one marketing job properly instead of answering as a generic chatbot.

Everything below is a factual statement about the product as sold today. Prices are the published list prices and include no hidden fees.

## Site
- Company site (agency + courses): https://genmarketer.hu/
- Product landing, Hungarian: https://ai-csapat.genmarketer.hu/
- English product landing: https://genmarketer.eu/
- Knowledge base and Hungarian checkout: https://tudastar.genmarketer.hu/

## What you get
- Product: „Az AI csapatod" (Hungarian) / „Your AI team" (English)
- 28 available specialists across seven areas: leadership and strategy, advertising, landing page, design and Figma, video, SEO, customer and revenue.
- Format: Claude Skills and ChatGPT-compatible packages, plus written training material and installation guides for Claude, Claude Code and ChatGPT.
- Typical jobs: market and ICP research, competitor and ad-library research, campaign planning, ad copywriting, Meta Ads and Google Ads management, landing page design and build, creative and Figma design, video scripting, UGC and ad-video production, keyword research, technical SEO and SEO audits, local SEO, email sequences, membership and recurring-revenue design, LinkedIn presence.
- New specialists keep arriving and existing ones keep improving; on a subscription those updates are included for as long as the subscription runs.

## The 28 specialists
- Leadership and strategy: ATLASZ (team lead — routes every task to the right specialist), ATHÉNÉ (strategic partner), SUN TZU (competitor analyst), SHERLOCK (market researcher)
- Advertising: KEPLER (ad planner), CYRANO (ad copywriter), AURORA (Facebook/Meta Ads expert), APOLLÓN (Google Ads manager)
- Landing page: MIDÁSZ (landing page expert), ROBINSON (landing page builder)
- Design and Figma: LEONARDO (creative designer), MATISSE (Figma designer), NEXUS (Figma-to-code bridge), SENTRY (Figma QA reviewer), VECTOR (ad image resizer for 1:1, 4:5, 9:16, 16:9 and 2:3)
- Video: GULLIVER (video data collector), SEHEREZÁDÉ (video script writer), LUMIÈRE (UGC video producer), KRONOSZ (video editor), GUTENBERG (video renderer)
- SEO: KOLUMBUSZ (keyword researcher), PARETO (content optimizer), MERIDIAN (technical SEO expert), VERITAS (SEO auditor), ARTEMISZ (local SEO expert)
- Customer and revenue: HERMÉSZ (email expert), PERPETUUM (membership expert), FIGARO (LinkedIn specialist)

## Pricing
- Hungarian pricing model: three offers. Two subscriptions, each billable monthly or every six months — Standard 9 990 HUF/month or 39 960 HUF per six months, and Pro 19 990 HUF/month or 79 960 HUF per six months. The six-month rate equals four monthly payments, so half a year costs two months less than paying monthly, and it renews every six months at that same rate. No minimum term, cancel anytime, plan switching allowed — plus one single payment package, Skillpakk 34 990 HUF one-off.
- English pricing model: three offers, mirroring the Hungarian structure in euros. Two subscriptions, each billable monthly or every six months — Planner 29 EUR/month or 116 EUR per six months, and Autopilot 59 EUR/month or 236 EUR per six months. The six-month rate equals four monthly payments, so half a year costs two months less than paying monthly, and it renews every six months at that same rate. No minimum term, cancel anytime, plan switching allowed — plus one single payment package, Training 189 EUR one-off, which includes NO further updates (you keep the team as it stands on the day of purchase) and a 30-day money-back guarantee.
- Plan difference: Standard researches, audits and produces ready-to-use plans and copy; Pro also connects to the customer's own Meta Ads, Google Ads, MailerLite and GA4 accounts and executes the approved work there. Skillpakk is the same specialist team bought outright: no monthly fee, no account connectors and NO updates — the customer downloads the team as it stands on the purchase date and keeps exactly that; a 30-day money-back guarantee applies.
- All three offers include the full 28-strong team. The difference is execution rights and billing, not the number of specialists.
- Price lock: while a subscription stays active, the rate the customer joined at does not rise, even as the team grows. It only resets if the customer cancels and returns later.
- Purchase path: the Hungarian landing sends buyers to the GENmarketer knowledge base checkout (WooCommerce, HUF) for all three offers; the English landing sends buyers to the English store at vip.genmarketer.eu (WooCommerce, EUR), with the chosen plan and billing cycle already in the cart. The two never mix: each side has its own shop, its own currency and its own subscriptions.
- Subscription self-service EN: https://vip.genmarketer.eu/my-account/ — the customer signs in to the English store to change card, download invoices, switch plan or cancel.

## What you need before buying
- A Claude or a ChatGPT account. The specialists run inside it; they are not hosted by GENmarketer.
- Claude's free tier is enough for many tasks. For heavier use Claude Pro (about 20 EUR/month) or Claude Code is recommended. That fee is paid directly to Anthropic and is not part of the GENmarketer price.
- Autopilot additionally needs the customer's own advertising and analytics accounts (Meta Ads, Google Ads, GA4, Search Console, MailerLite) to connect to. GENmarketer does not supply those accounts or the ad budget.
- No coding skill is required. Every specialist ships with a simple upload guide for Claude or ChatGPT and a command for Claude Code.

## What this is NOT
- It is not human done-for-you agency work. The specialists run inside the customer's own AI account and the customer stays in control. GENmarketer does sell separate agency services, but those are a different offering at https://genmarketer.hu/.
- It is not a standalone SaaS product with its own dashboard or its own model. There is no GENmarketer app to log into for the day-to-day work — the workspace is the customer's Claude or ChatGPT.
- It does not include advertising spend. Meta and Google still charge the customer's own budget directly.
- It does not include the Claude or ChatGPT subscription fee.
- Autopilot keeps the customer in control: new ad assets start paused by default; a customer can approve one exact execution or deliberately enable revocable approval-free operation for that connector.
- It is not a fit for someone who does not want to use Claude or ChatGPT at all, or who wants results without choosing and supervising an approval mode.

## Guarantees and cancellation
- Subscriptions: no minimum term and no notice period. Cancelling stops future payments; access continues to the end of the billing period already paid for (the month or the year). Cancelling is one click from the link in the welcome e-mail, or from the subscription self-service page.
- One-off Training package: 30-day money-back guarantee — one e-mail is enough. What was bought stays the customer's permanently, but it is a snapshot: no updates, no new specialists and no reworked material follow a one-off purchase. Continuous updates are a subscription-only benefit.
- Switching between Planner and Autopilot works in both directions and applies from the next payment; nothing is charged twice.

## Language and support
- The specialists read the brief and reply in whichever language the customer writes in, because they run inside the customer's own AI.
- The English specialist packages, written guides and examples are in English; the Hungarian ones are in Hungarian.
- Support is by e-mail, in English on the English channel and in Hungarian on the Hungarian one: info@genmarketer.hu

## AI and Search Context
- The product has one landing page per language, each a static site.
- The Hungarian one is https://ai-csapat.genmarketer.hu/.
- The English one is https://genmarketer.eu/, and since 2026-08-05 it is the x-default version: readers whose language is neither Hungarian nor explicitly matched should be pointed at the English page. The former English path, https://ai-csapat.genmarketer.hu/en/, has redirected to it with a permanent, path-preserving 301 since 2026-08-02; do not cite the old path.
- Canonical URLs and hreflang alternates are declared in the HTML head and sitemap.
- Structured data includes Organization (with legal name, registered address and tax ID), Person (founder), WebSite, WebPage, BreadcrumbList, Product, AggregateOffer with five nested Offers, ImageObject, ItemList and FAQPage entities. The Hungarian landing additionally carries five VideoObject entities, one per on-page demo video, and the AggregateOffer wrapper whose lowPrice is the cheapest plan; the English landing still uses the older flat Offer list and has no VideoObject entities.
- The interactive specialist grid on the landing is rendered client-side; the same roster is also present as plain text inside a noscript block and as a JSON-LD ItemList, on BOTH language versions, so it can be read without executing JavaScript.
- AI crawlers are explicitly allowed in robots.txt, including the retrieval and user-triggered agents that produce citations.

## Demo videos on the Hungarian landing
Five short demo clips are embedded on https://ai-csapat.genmarketer.hu/ and are declared as VideoObject structured data. They are the product's own output, not stock footage. Each one is muted, looping and under 35 seconds.
- Motion ad creative (5s): https://ai-csapat.genmarketer.hu/assets/video/kreativ-motion.mp4 — a moving ad creative produced by the creative pair LEONARDO and KEPLER from a single brief.
- Video editing and subtitling (34s): https://ai-csapat.genmarketer.hu/assets/video/demo-kreativ.mp4 — KRONOSZ reads a recording stored on the customer's own machine and returns a finished, subtitled video.
- AI-generated video ad, no shoot (15s): https://ai-csapat.genmarketer.hu/assets/video/demo-video-ad.mp4 — SEHEREZÁDÉ and GUTENBERG take the job from script to finished ad video inside Claude or ChatGPT.
- UGC video, product demo (12s): https://ai-csapat.genmarketer.hu/assets/video/demo-ugc.mp4 — LUMIÈRE writes the script, generates the presenter image and produces the finished clip from one short prompt.
- UGC video, presenter scene (13s): https://ai-csapat.genmarketer.hu/assets/video/ugc-example-2.mp4 — a presenter-led UGC scene produced entirely with AI: no shoot, no crew, no cast.

## Audience
- Solo entrepreneurs
- Small agencies
- In-house marketers
- Course buyers who want a practical AI marketing workflow

## Frequently asked questions
- These are the questions and answers published on the English landing page. The Hungarian page at https://ai-csapat.genmarketer.hu/ carries its own FAQ (35 questions), which covers the same ground plus Hungary-specific billing; the two are maintained separately and may differ.
### Is this for me?
- How do I know which specialist to call? — You don't – and you don't need to. You describe the job to the team lead, in your own words: “I want to advertise my coffee shop.” It puts the team together for you: it picks the specialists the job needs and the account connections that go with them, puts them in the order that works best, and sees the work through – where a job takes more than one pass, it runs the same specialist again. Your only job is to say what you want to achieve.
- I am not an AI person. Will this work for me? — Yes. There is no coding and no prompt engineering: you talk to the specialists in chat, in your own words, the way you would brief a colleague. They ask you for what they need to know – your job is to answer, not to phrase a command. Installation comes with an illustrated walkthrough, and if you get stuck, write to us and we will go through it with you.
- I already work with an agency. Does this still make sense? — Yes, and not instead of them. Start with the audit: the team goes through your ad accounts, your tracking and your emails, and shows you what made money and what did not. That does not make your agency worse – it makes you a better client, because you know exactly what to ask for. What you keep in-house and what you outsource stays your call.
- Does it only advise, or does it do the work? — That depends on the package. Planner researches, audits, plans and writes the copy; execution stays with you. Autopilot can also use supported connectors in accounts you choose. Changes start paused or in draft, are read back after execution and go live only under the approval setting you select.
### What do you need?
- Do I need a Claude account? Is a free one enough? — One AI account is enough, and you can start on a free plan. Claude free: you can upload our specialists (Settings → Capabilities → turn on “Code execution and file creation”, then Customize → Skills), and it also allows one custom connector – which is exactly how many we need. So a free account carries the whole team and the connection. Why you might still pay: Claude Pro gives you more allowance, not more capability, while Cowork and Claude Code require a paid Claude plan – neither is needed to get started.
- Does it work with both Claude and ChatGPT? — Yes – the specialists work with both Claude and ChatGPT. We built them on Claude because that is where the specialist experience is best, and where a free plan already carries both the upload and the single custom connector we need. You are not locked in: ChatGPT (and Codex) can convert our specialists to work there too, on their own. If you get stuck, write to us at info@genmarketer.hu and we will help you through it.
- How do I install it? How long does it take? — About ten minutes, by clicking. Every specialist comes with two kinds of guide: a simple upload for Claude, Cowork or ChatGPT, and a command for Claude Code – both with an illustrated walkthrough. If you get stuck at any point, write to us and we will go through it with you; if it is easier that way, we set it up together on a call.
- Do I really use it in my language? — Yes. Each specialist runs inside your own AI (Claude or ChatGPT), so it reads your brief and replies in whichever language you write in. The specialists, the written guide and the examples are all in English.
- What does Claude cost on top of this? — Nothing is compulsory. A free Claude account is enough to start and to produce your first pieces of work. For heavier workloads Claude Pro (around 20 dollars a month) is more comfortable – it gives you more allowance, not more capability – and Cowork and Claude Code require a paid plan. Whatever you pay for your AI account goes to Anthropic or OpenAI directly; it is not part of any GENmarketer plan.
- Do I need my own website or ad account? — Not to use the team – research, plans, copy and creative only need your own AI account. The Autopilot connectors do need them: that is where it works, inside your own Meta Ads, Google Ads, GA4 or MailerLite account. If one of them does not exist yet, we can help you set it up – and until then that specialist hands you a plan instead, while the rest of the team carries on.
- Will I run out of my Claude allowance? — An ad copy set, a landing page plan or a competitor table fits inside the free allowance, because the team lead only starts the specialists a task actually needs rather than the whole team. On heavy days Claude Pro or Claude Code is more comfortable, but you do not need either to start. On what it costs: a subscription is not billed per token – see the pricing section for the detail.
- Do I need a paid MailerLite plan? — Not necessarily. The email specialist writes and assembles your sequences on the free plan too. A few of MailerLite’s more advanced automations live on their paid tiers – when that happens, the specialist either suggests a way around it or tells you plainly that this one needs a plan upgrade. It will not talk around it.
### How does it work?
- What exactly does the team lead do? — It is the conductor, and it does four things. It learns your business once – about five questions, and from then on every specialist reads that, so you never have to explain what you do again. It assembles the team for the job: it picks the relevant specialists and the account connections they need, from the live list rather than from memory – and it tells you if a connector is not connected yet. It puts them in order: for a bigger goal you get a sequence rather than a single answer – customer profile, ad plan, ad copy, creative, landing page plan, measurement – and it says who goes first and who builds on that. Finally, it sees the work through: where a job takes more than one pass it runs the same specialist again, and hands the result to the next one. You never need to know a single specialist's name.
- Do they always work from the latest knowledge? — Yes. For every task the team lead pulls that specialist's current material live, rather than working from its own memory. So when we improve a specialist – a new platform rule, a new way of measuring, a better method – it is there for you straight away, with nothing to reinstall. That is the point of the subscription. The one-off Training package is the opposite: it is the snapshot that was valid on the day you bought it, and it does not update.
- How long until I have my first finished piece of work? — Installation usually takes about ten minutes, although the exact time depends on your platform and account. You can start your first brief immediately afterwards; completion time depends on the task, the source material and the review it needs.
- How do I know that what it tells me is true? — That is a hard rule for us: every specialist has to say when it does not have the data, instead of inventing it – and to name its own limits. Where numbers matter – ad performance, keywords, list data – it works from the real data in your own account, not from memory. And Autopilot reads back every change it makes.
- How is this different from Meta's and Google's built-in AI? — They can help with tasks inside their own platforms, but they work differently. GENmarketer is designed to coordinate research, strategy, copy, creative direction and supported account work across a wider workflow, using the business context you provide. Connector actions are read back so you can verify the resulting state.
- How is this more than a prompt collection? — The difference is maintenance. Behind the specialists sits collected expert knowledge, wired-up account connectors and continuous market tracking that we keep current – and the ad platforms change every month. A prompt collection stops where it was written; this team moves on with you. Build it yourself and you are not paying for prompts, you are paying with your own time.
- I already have a reporting tool. How is this different? — A reporting tool reads: it lays out the numbers and leaves the conclusion to you. The team reads the same numbers, tells you what they mean and what to do about it – and with Autopilot it makes the fix in the same conversation. Our reporting ends where most tools would have you start working.
### What happens to my accounts?
- What exactly does Autopilot do in my accounts? — It can audit supported Meta Ads, Google Ads, GA4, Search Console and MailerLite accounts, prepare campaigns or email sequences and implement supported changes. New campaign assets start paused or in draft unless your current connector approval explicitly allows publication. After every write it reads the result back so you can verify what changed.
- Can I manage several ad accounts? What if I log in as a manager on someone else’s account? — One licence is one login – effectively one e-mail address, one person. But that one person can manage any number of ad accounts. When you connect, you authorise your own Meta and Google login, and whatever that login can reach, the team can work on: your own accounts, and also the client accounts you reach through a Business portfolio (Meta) or a manager account (Google Ads MCC). If you look after several companies’ accounts, that does not need extra licences – it only needs your login to see them. While you work you always name the account in question, and the team works account by account: two clients’ data never mixes, and approval stays a separate question per account. You need a second licence when a colleague wants their own login – account connections are tied to a person. Pick one to five seats next to the packages.
- Who decides on spending? — You do. Your daily and campaign-level spending limits stay where they are today – in your own ad account – and the team works inside them. There is no wallet on our side that it could reach. You also choose how it works: for each connector you can approve one exact execution, or grant approval-free operation until you revoke it, and you can revoke connector access at any time. New ad assets start paused by default.
- Who connects my accounts? — You grant the access yourself, but you are not left alone with it. It takes about two minutes per connector, by clicking, on the provider's own sign-in page (Meta, Google, MailerLite) – so you never hand us a password. If you get stuck on any of them, tell us and we will do it together: we walk you through it, or we set it up with you on a call.
- What happens to my data? — The specialists run inside your own AI account – your briefs and your copy are created there and stay there. For account connections you grant the access yourself, per connector, and you can revoke it at any time; the access only covers the account you picked. Details are in our Privacy Notice.
### What does it cost?
- What's the difference between the packages? — All three include the 28-specialist team. Planner (€29/month) covers research, audits, strategy and copy; execution stays with you. Autopilot (€59/month) also adds supported connectors for accounts you choose, with paused-by-default execution and configurable approval. Training (€189 once) is a fixed snapshot of the team on the day you buy: no monthly fee, connectors or future updates.
- How many tokens does it burn? Will it push up my AI subscription bill? — No, and there is a structural reason: a Claude or ChatGPT subscription is not billed per token. You pay a flat monthly fee that comes with an allowance – on Claude, a session window that restarts every five hours plus a weekly cap. Per-token billing only exists on the developer API, and our team does not use it: you will never get a token bill from us, and your AI account will not cost more because you work with us. What we do influence is how fast the allowance goes: the team lead only starts the specialists a task actually needs – never the whole team for every question. An ad copy set, a landing page plan or a competitor table therefore fits inside the free allowance. If you work with the team daily, Claude Pro (around 20 dollars a month) is more comfortable – it gives you more allowance, not more capability – and you pay Anthropic directly, not us.
- Which is right for me: Training or a subscription? — If you want the team to keep pace with the market, the subscription is the better choice: new specialists appear automatically, the existing ones keep improving, and we follow the ad platforms' changes for you. Training is the other way round: it is today's team, downloaded. You get the state it is in on the day you buy, and it stays that way — no updates are included. We would rather say that plainly, because finding it out later would be a disappointment. We keep the one-off option because some people simply do not want a subscription. You can switch at any time: buying Training does not stop you subscribing later.
- Is there a cheaper, longer billing cycle? — Yes, on both subscription packages there is 6-month billing. Planner is €116 per 6 months and Autopilot is €236 per 6 months – you pay for four months and get six, so two months are free. Use the switch next to the packages to move between monthly and 6-month billing. It renews every 6 months at the same rate, with no minimum term – cancel anytime.
- Will my price go up? — Not while you stay subscribed. The team keeps growing, and the list price rises with it – but the rate you joined at is the rate you keep. It only changes if you cancel and come back later. The one-off Training package has no recurring price at all – you pay once, at the price shown on the day you buy.
- Can I switch between Planner and Autopilot? — Yes, in either direction, from your subscription page. The change applies from your next monthly payment – nothing is charged twice. If you bought the one-off Training package, you can subscribe later at any time to keep the team growing with you.
- Do I get an invoice? Can I buy as a company? — Yes. Every purchase gets an invoice, and you can buy as a company: the checkout has fields for your company name and VAT number, and both end up on the invoice. Fill them in before you pay — that is where the invoice details are set.
- How many people can use one subscription? — One licence is one login – and you can buy up to five seats in a single subscription. Pick the number next to the packages: every extra seat costs less than the one before. Each seat is a separate login with its own account connections, so your colleagues are not sharing yours. After you buy, write to us at info@genmarketer.hu with their e-mail addresses and we set the extra logins up for you. Above five people, ask us for a quote. Starting with one is still a perfectly good way in – you can add seats later without starting over. Note: several ad accounts does not mean several licences – one login can manage many, as covered under “What happens to my accounts?”.
### Risk and guarantee
- How long does the team keep updating? — On a subscription, for as long as you subscribe: new specialists appear automatically and the existing ones keep improving – largely based on subscribers' feedback. The one-off Training package is a snapshot: you download the team as it stands on the day you buy, and no updates follow — no new specialists, no reworked material. What you downloaded stays yours for good; if you later want the team to keep pace with you, you can subscribe at any time.
- How much am I risking? — Very little, and you hold it. On a subscription: cancel and you stop paying – there is no minimum term and no notice period. You keep access to the end of the month you have already paid for, and cancelling takes one click from the link in your welcome e-mail. On the one-off Training package you have a 30-day money-back guarantee – one e-mail is enough.
- Is there customer support? — Yes. If you get stuck with anything – installation, connecting an account, usage, billing – write to us at info@genmarketer.hu and we will help, in English. If it is faster, we can walk through it together on a call.
